paper_title: Constraints on the Coupling between Axionlike Dark Matter and Photons Using an Antiproton Superconducting Tuned Detection Circuit in a Cryogenic Penning Trap
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Haloscope-type search using superconducting LC detection circuit of BASE Penning trap. Constrains g_agamma < 1e-11 GeV^-1 (95% CL) for ALP masses 2.7906-2.7914 neV/c^2 (nu_z ~ 674.9 kHz). Local DM density rho_a = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed.
